briefing.summary: Just touched down on runway 35 at Canberra. Tower has instructed you to vacate via the next taxiway.

lastTransmission.speaker: atc
lastTransmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, vacate next right via Bravo, contact Ground one two one decimal nine.

challenge.expectedText: Vacate next right via Bravo, Ground one two one decimal nine, Mike X-ray Golf.

elements.label: Vacate instruction
elements.hint: Include the taxiway you'll vacate onto so Tower knows your routing.

elements.label: Frequency
accept: Ground one two one decimal nine

challenge.explanation: MATS Part 4: vacate instructions don't have to be read back verbatim, but the frequency change does. In practice, reading back both confirms the routing for Tower.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Mandatory readback items — frequency change.
